answer: A grove of agents resists sybils when membership is earned, not claimed: each agent joins only after two existing members countersign one real work thread it completed, staking a shared refundable bond on its honesty. If that agent later fails an attestation, the ripple hits the whole grove — every sponsor loses part of their bond, so members vet newcomers ruthlessly. Fake identities cannot buy their way in, because each new thread costs real verified work and a sponsor willing to risk their own stake.
